info.title: 101cloud Backend API
info.description: Implemented Go/Gin/MySQL/GORM control plane. Numeric IDs and money are strings; time is RFC3339 +08:00. No NAT or arbitrary Incus proxy. Custom-instance applications happen outside the platform; only administrators provision or import custom instances, with approved_config retained as the public configuration field, not an approval record. No custom-instance application or review operations exist. List items use exactly the same representation as the resource detail: JSON columns are decoded objects/arrays (never JSON-encoded strings), booleans are true/false (never 1/0), every revision is a decimal string. Every policy version reference in requests and responses (pricing_version_id, gpu_price_version_id, policy_version_id, policy_versions values, catalog gpu-option id) is a policy_versions id as returned by /admin/policies/{kind}/versions; an id of the wrong kind is 422 validation_failed. See 后端接口文档.md for workflow and policy boundaries.

patch.description: Administrator required. range_start and range_end may be changed independently within the existing subnet. Invalid bounds or a gateway within the resulting range return 422 invalid_network. Excluding any registered IP returns 409 pool_range_in_use. Range-only updates preserve allocations and verified bindings and do not register or probe IPs.

delete.description: Administrator deletion requires confirm_name matching the exact instance name and delete_data:true. Running instances additionally require mode:force and confirm_data_loss_risk:true. One durable backend task persists force=true, confirms force stop before Agent DELETE, then obtains fresh GPU occupancy evidence before releasing allocations. Timeouts and unknown outcomes retain reservations and reconcile the recorded operation; clients must not orchestrate stop/delete.

mode.description: Must be force when deleting a running instance; administrator only. The durable task persists force=true.

confirm_data_loss_risk.description: Must be true with mode:force for a running instance. Force stop may lose unsaved data.

gpu.description: Plan GPU offering; only count/model/access_mode/max_hourly_pt apply. VM plans: count 0, model null, no gpu_count override with max > 0. Container plans: model null requires count 0 and no gpu_count override max > 0; model set requires count > 0, or count 0 with allowed_overrides.gpu_count.max >= 1 (optional GPU). get.description: Administrator read-only preview using the instance owner's quota, node capacity and custom resident budget. No capacity bypass, agent query, pricing or reservation; missing quota or unavailable node fails closed.

post.description: Administrator resize within owner quota, node capacity and resident budget; disk shrinking is forbidden. A running instance requires confirm_restart:true and one durable backend task gracefully stops, confirms configuration, then restarts it; a stopped instance stays stopped. No client stop/start choreography. Recovery never replays stop or resize after start intent.

confirm_restart.description: Optional for stopped instances; must be true for running instances to authorize graceful stop, resize and restart in one durable task.

get.description: Read-only capacity preview for an owned instance; requires resize permission. Never queries the agent, prices or reserves resources. Missing owner quota, inactive owner, exceeded instance counts and unavailable/stale/unverified nodes fail closed.

403.description: Resize not permitted or owner inactive

404.description: Instance not found (including other owners) or node missing

post.description: Resize an owned instance within plan, quota, node capacity and resident budget; disk shrinking is forbidden. A running instance requires confirm_restart:true; nonadministrator custom instances additionally require resize, stop and start permissions. One durable backend task gracefully stops, confirms configuration and restarts; stopped instances stay stopped. No client stop/start choreography; recovery never replays stop or resize after start intent.

confirm_restart.description: Optional for stopped instances; must be true for running instances. Nonadministrator custom instances require resize, stop and start permissions.

post.description: Revokes all sessions of the user on success. A wrong current_password returns 401 invalid_credentials and leaves the current session valid; 401 unauthenticated means the session itself is missing, expired or revoked.

session.description: HttpOnly session cookie. Name depends on the CLOUD_ORIGIN scheme: https -> __Host-101cloud_session (Secure); http (local development only) -> 101cloud_session (not Secure). The CSRF browser-context cookie follows the same rule (__Host-101cloud_csrf / 101cloud_csrf).

max_resources.description: Total allowed instance size, excluding its own reservation; min of owner quota, node capacity and custom resident budget. Not an increment or a reservation; POST revalidates. Plan bounds and disk no-shrink still apply.

gpu.description: Only count/model/access_mode/max_hourly_pt apply. count 0 opts out of GPUs on any plan, regardless of the plan's base count or gpu_count.min: model must be null, the plan's model/access_mode/price limit are not compared, and gpu_hourly_pt is 0. count > 0 requires a container plan that offers GPUs; count must equal the plan base or fit allowed_overrides.gpu_count min/max/step; model and access_mode must equal the plan's; max_hourly_pt must not exceed the plan limit; the image must be gpu_ready. Violations return 422 validation_failed.
Same rules as ElasticSpec.gpu: count 0 opts out of GPUs on any plan (model null, no GPU charge); count > 0 must match the plan's GPU offering.

node_id.description: Required for POST /admin/custom-instances; imports use the route node, and a supplied value must match it.

PublicTaskError.description: Explicitly public safe error only. Resource amounts in details are decimal strings, never floating-point numbers; no raw upstream output or parameters. For unknown deletion tasks, gpu_reclamation_unverified means native deletion is confirmed but independent post-deletion GPU evidence is not: details include stage=delete.verify_reclamation, safe reason, native_deletion_confirmed=true, resource_reservations_released=false and a Chinese action. Keep all reservations and reconcile the original task; do not issue another DELETE. No raw GPU process data is exposed.

phase.description: Deletion progresses through delete.native, delete.verify_reclamation and delete.finalize. GPU evidence waits up to about 95 seconds for an explicitly complete host-attributed sample whose collection started after native absence confirmation. A verification failure remains unknown, not an assertion that native deletion failed.

resource_reservations_released.description: True only after atomic, proven pre-dispatch creation reservation cancellation. False is not evidence that a guest exists.
Only a failed, proven never-dispatched creation with completed atomic reservation release reports true.

capabilities.description: UI hints only; server reauthorizes each request. Resize/delete require ready provisioning and fresh observed state. Running delete is administrator-only; running custom resize by nonadministrators requires resize, stop and start permissions.

resize.description: Whether stopped/running resize is available; running requests still require confirm_restart:true.

delete.description: Whether deletion is available; running deletion still requires administrator mode:force and explicit risk, exact-name and data confirmations.

LimitsView.description: Effective quota object returned by GET /me (limits), GET and PUT /admin/users/{id}/limits.

ConsoleSession.description: No fixed console duration. The bound login session and permissions must remain valid; expired is retained only for historical records.

shutdown_grace_seconds.description: Explicit configured grace; existing deadline events retain their captured value.

gpu.description: Plan GPU offering; only count/model/access_mode/max_hourly_pt apply. VM plans: count 0, model null, no gpu_count override with max > 0. Container plans: model null requires count 0 and no gpu_count override max > 0; model set requires count > 0, or count 0 with allowed_overrides.gpu_count.max >= 1 (optional GPU). A plan with a model requires policy_versions.gpu-pricing. Only count > 0 requires every image to be gpu_ready. Violations return 422 validation_failed.

code.description: Optional. Empty or omitted defaults to the first 12 hex characters of fingerprint; the generated name then becomes "os_name os_release (code)".

version.description: Optional. Empty or omitted defaults to "1".
